title: Feature flags
subtitle: Turn whole features off for everyone, with or without an update explaining it; admins keep access so they can turn it back on.

disableDialog.title: Turn off {label}?
disableDialog.description: Everyone except admins loses access right away. Admins keep it so they can turn it back on.
disableDialog.messageHint: What people are told while it's off.
disableDialog.postHint: Everyone sees it under Updates. Turning it back on adds a follow-up.
disableDialog.quietHint: Nobody is told for now. You can still post it later from Feature flags.

enableDialog.title: Turn {label} back on?
enableDialog.description: {label} comes back for everyone right away.
enableDialog.noUpdate: No update went out when it was turned off, so nothing is posted now.
enableDialog.followUpHint: Added to the update that went out when it was turned off. Leave it empty to just say it's back.

disabledScreen.title: {label} is disabled
disabledScreen.description: This feature has been disabled by an administrator. Please contact your administrator for further inquiries.

postDialog.title: Post an update about {label}
postDialog.description: Everyone will see why {label} is off. Turning it back on adds a follow-up to this update.
postDialog.messageHint: Also what people are told while it's off.

waiting: {count, plural, one {# visitor is} other {# visitors are}} waiting to hear the forms are back. They get a mail when you turn them on.
statusHint: Turning a feature off hides it from everyone except admins, straight away. You decide each time whether an update goes out.
summaryOff: {count, plural, one {# of {total} features is off} other {# of {total} features are off}}
summaryNoUpdate: {count, plural, one {# without an update} other {# without an update}}

descriptions.chat: Direct and group messages between colleagues.
descriptions.ai: Everything that sends requests to the AI model.
descriptions.marketingSubmissions: The contact forms on the public website. While off, visitors can leave their email to be told when they're back.

maintenanceScreen.title: Currently being reworked
maintenanceScreen.description: IT is reworking this area, so it is temporarily unavailable. We'll open it again as soon as it's ready.
